info.title: External registers
info.description: Sourced schemas for the basisregistraties a municipality must consult: an address from the BAG, a parcel from the BRK and a WOZ value. Each record is read live through the openconnector-http object source and shown by the external-register leaf on another object; nothing is stored. Every schema is off until an administrator names its OpenConnector source.

x-openregister.description: Example sourced schemas for the external-register leaf, off until a source is configured.

external-registers.title: External registers
external-registers.description: Records read live from the basisregistraties, never stored.

bag-adres.title: BAG address
bag-adres.summary: An address from the BAG, read live by its nummeraanduiding.
bag-adres.description: Served by the openconnector-http object source and never stored. Off until an administrator names the OpenConnector source that holds the BAG credentials in config.source; until then the external-register leaf explains that the register is not configured. The find path follows the BAG Individuele Bevragingen API; a mapping (config.mapping) can reshape another source's answer into these fields.

nummeraanduidingIdentificatie.title: Nummeraanduiding
nummeraanduidingIdentificatie.description: The 16-digit BAG nummeraanduiding id the address is found by.

huisletter.title: House letter
huisletter.description: The house letter, when there is one.

huisnummertoevoeging.title: Addition
huisnummertoevoeging.description: The house number addition, when there is one.

adresseerbaarObjectIdentificatie.title: Addressable object
adresseerbaarObjectIdentificatie.description: The BAG id of the residential object, berth or pitch the address belongs to.

brk-perceel.title: BRK parcel
brk-perceel.summary: A cadastral parcel from the BRK, read live by its identification.
brk-perceel.description: Served by the openconnector-http object source and never stored. Off until an administrator names the OpenConnector source for the BRK in config.source. The find path follows the BRK Bevragen API.

identificatie.title: Identification
identificatie.description: The cadastral object id the parcel is found by.

kadastraleAanduiding.title: Cadastral designation
kadastraleAanduiding.description: Municipality, section and parcel number as one designation.

kadastraleGrootte.title: Size
kadastraleGrootte.description: The cadastral size in square metres.

aardCultuurBebouwd.title: Use
aardCultuurBebouwd.description: The cultivation or built-up type the BRK records.

zakelijkGerechtigdeIdentificaties.title: Holders of rights
zakelijkGerechtigdeIdentificaties.description: The ids of the holders of real rights, as the source answers them.

woz-waarde.title: WOZ value
woz-waarde.summary: The WOZ object and its assessed values, read live by the WOZ object number.
woz-waarde.description: Served by the openconnector-http object source and never stored. Off until an administrator names the OpenConnector source for the WOZ in config.source. The find path follows the WOZ Bevragen API.

wozobjectnummer.title: WOZ object number
wozobjectnummer.description: The WOZ object number the record is found by.

vastgesteldeWaarde.title: Assessed value
vastgesteldeWaarde.description: The most recent assessed value, in euros.

waardepeildatum.title: Valuation date
waardepeildatum.description: The reference date of that value.

adresseerbaarObjectIdentificatie.title: Addressable object
adresseerbaarObjectIdentificatie.description: The BAG id of the object the value is for.
